name: english-co-reading
description: A persistent English co-reading and review system with exact sentence resume, confirmed speech practice, a human-readable notebook, and privacy-safe sharing.

interface.shortDescription: Read, resume exactly, review, and share English learning.
interface.longDescription: A private, durable English-learning system for original books. Resume at the exact sentence, confirm speech recognition before correction, keep a readable review notebook, separate literal meaning from natural translation and literary inference, and export privacy-safe study materials.
defaultPrompt: Continue my English book with a short passage and discussion.
Review vocabulary from my current English book.
Open my review notebook and start a review.
Let me retell today's passage, then confirm the transcript before correcting my English.
